sources.entry: Mana Security - vulnerability management app for individuals. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/manasecurity/mana-security-app)

summary.one_liner: Mana Security is a macOS vulnerability management app that monitors installed apps for known and potential vulnerabilities.
keywords: find outdated vulnerable apps on mac
use_cases: Monitor installed macOS apps for known vulnerabilities
Get alerted to new CVEs affecting software on a Mac
Track how quickly apps are patched compared with benchmarks
Individual security hygiene for a personal Mac
how_to_run: git clone <repository URL> (the README's clone command is missing the URL)
notable: Continuous monitoring of 100+ apps against known and potential vulnerabilities
Detects new vulnerabilities as soon as they appear in public databases such as CVE
Compares patching velocity against community and other benchmarks
caveats: README is brief and the clone command has no URL; setup steps are minimal
License not stated in the README
No platform beyond macOS is mentioned
